description: This Java class defines GenericFileFilter, a custom file filter extending javax.swing.filechooser.FileFilter. It allows filtering files based on specified extensions, providing methods to accept files, add extensions, and generate descriptive labels for use in file choosers.

classes.name: GenericFileFilter
classes.description: A file filter for use with JFileChooser that filters files based on extension patterns, with customizable descriptions.

methods.name: GenericFileFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with a description and allowed extensions.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines if a file should be accepted based on directory status or extension match.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Extracts and returns the extension of a filename, in lowercase.

methods.name: addExtension
methods.description: Adds an extension to the filter's set of allowed extensions.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Generates and returns a description string for the filter, including list of extensions if applicable.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description string for this filter.

methods.name: setExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Sets whether the extension list should be included in the description string.

methods.name: isExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Checks if extensions are included in the description string.
